import CategoryTheory.Abelian
import CategoryTheory.Localization
import CategoryTheory.SerreClass

open CategoryTheory

theorem lg_target {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] [CategoryTheory.Abelian C] (P : CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty C) [P.IsSerreClass] : P.isoModSerre.HasLeftCalculusOfFractions := by
  let S : Set (Object C) := P.objs
  let D : Subcategory C := Subcategory.ofSet S
  have hSerre : D.isSerreClass := by
    refine Subcategory.isSerreClass_of_isSerreClass _ P.IsSerreClass
  have hAbelian : D.isAbelian := by
    exact Subcategory.isAbelian_of_isSerreClass D hSerre
  have hKernels : D.hasKernels := by
    exact Subcategory.hasKernels_of_isAbelian D hAbelian
  have hCokernels : D.hasCokernels := by
    exact Subcategory.hasCokernels_of_isAbelian D hAbelian
  have hZeroObjects : D.hasZeroObjects := by
    exact Subcategory.hasZeroObjects_of_isAbelian D hAbelian
  have hBinaryProducts : D.hasBinaryProducts := by
    exact Subcategory.hasBinaryProducts_of_isAbelian D hAbelian
  have hBinaryCoproducts : D.hasBinaryCoproducts := by
    exact Subcategory.hasBinaryCoproducts_of_isAbelian D hAbelian
  have hEqualizers : D.hasEqualizers := by
    exact Subcategory.hasEqualizers_of_isAbelian D hAbelian
  have hCoequalizers : D.hasCoequalizers := by
    exact Subcategory.hasCoequalizers_of_isAbelian D hAbelian
  have hReflective : D.isReflective := by
    rw [Subcategory.isReflective]
    refine ⟨_, _, _, _, _⟩
    · exact fun X Y f => ⟨_, _⟩
    · exact fun X Y f => ⟨_, _⟩
    · exact fun X Y f => ⟨_, _⟩
    · exact fun X Y f => ⟨_, _⟩
    · exact fun X Y f => ⟨_, _⟩
  have hLeftCalculus : D.isoModSerre.HasLeftCalculusOfFractions := by
    exact HasLeftCalculusOfFractions.of_isSerreClass D hSerre
  exact hLeftCalculus
